en.t: The official opening of Constantine's Bridge built over the Danube between Sucidava (Corabia, Romania) and Oescus (Gigen, Bulgaria) by the Roman architect Theophilus Patricius
en.s: Constantine's Bridge (Latin: Pons per Danuvium Ductus, Bulgarian: Константинов мост, Konstantinov most; Romanian: Podul lui Constantin cel Mare) was a Roman bridge over the Danube used to reconquer Dacia. It was completed in 328 AD and remained in use for four decades. It was officially opened on 5 July 328 AD in the presence of emperor Constantine the Great.

zh.t: 罗马建筑师狄奥菲卢斯·帕特里修斯建造的君士坦丁桥正式开放
zh.s: 君士坦丁桥（拉丁语：Pons per Danuvium Ductus；保加利亚语：Константинов мост，转写：Konstantinov most；罗马尼亚语：Podul lui Constantin cel Mare）是一座横跨多瑙河的罗马桥梁，曾用于收复达契亚。桥梁于公元328年建成，之后使用了四十年。公元328年7月5日，君士坦丁大帝出席了桥梁的正式开放仪式。

en.s: The Battle of Manolada was fought on July 5, 1316, at Manolada, on the plains of Elis in the Peloponnese. The two leaders were Louis of Burgundy and the infante Ferdinand of Majorca, both of whom claimed the Principality of Achaea in right of their wives. The defeat and death of Ferdinand ensured the continued Angevin supremacy over Achaea and checked the further movement of his allies, the Catalan Company then occupying the Duchy of Athens.

zh.s: 1316年7月5日，马诺拉达战役在伯罗奔尼撒半岛埃利斯平原的马诺拉达爆发。双方将领是勃艮第的路易和马略卡的费尔南多王子，两人都凭妻子的继承权主张亚该亚公国。费尔南多战败身亡，安茹王朝因此继续掌控亚该亚；他的盟友加泰罗尼亚佣兵团当时占据雅典公国，此战也阻止了这些盟友继续推进。

en.s: The Battle of Minatogawa (Japanese: 湊川の戦い), also known as the Battle of Minato River, was part of the Nanboku-chō Wars fought near the Minato River in Settsu Province (present day Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture) on 5 July 1336. The Imperial forces loyal to Emperor Go-Daigo led by Kusunoki Masashige and Nitta Yoshisada attempted to intercept the Ashikaga forces led by Ashikaga Takauji in Settsu.

zh.s: 凑川战役（日语：湊川の戦い），又称凑川之战，是南北朝战争的一部分，于1336年7月5日在摄津国凑川附近（今兵库县神户市）爆发。忠于后醍醐天皇的朝廷军由楠木正成和新田义贞率领，试图在摄津拦截足利尊氏率领的足利军。

en.s: The Battle of Çamurlu was fought on July 5, 1413, between Musa Çelebi and Mehmed Çelebi, both sons of Bayezid I, as the last conflict of the Ottoman civil war known as the Ottoman Interregnum. The battle decided which son of Bayezid I would finally reunite the Ottoman Empire, with Mehmed Çelebi becoming Mehmed I of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1413年7月5日，穆萨·切莱比与穆罕默德·切莱比在恰穆尔卢交战。两人都是巴耶济德一世的儿子，这场战役是奥斯曼帝国空位期内战的最后一场冲突。战役决定了由哪位巴耶济德一世之子重新统一奥斯曼帝国；穆罕默德·切莱比最终成为奥斯曼帝国的穆罕默德一世。

en.t: The Maronite College is established in Rome
en.s: The Pontifical Maronite College (Italian: Pontificio Collegio dei Maroniti) is one of the Roman Colleges of the Catholic Church. Founded originally in 1584 in order to educate Maronite priests, the college provides now higher education to priests from also other Eastern denominations and serves as the pastoral mission for the adjacent church of St Maron and the Procuracy of the Patriarchate of Antioch of the Maronites to the Holy See.

zh.t: 马龙派学院在罗马成立
zh.s: 宗座马龙派学院（意大利语：Pontificio Collegio dei Maroniti）是天主教会设于罗马的学院之一。学院最初于1584年创立，旨在培养马龙派司铎；如今也为其他东方教会的司铎提供高等教育，并承担毗邻圣马龙教堂的牧灵使命，以及马龙派安提阿宗主教驻圣座代表处的事务。

en.s: The siege of Steenwijk was a siege that took place between 30 May and 5 July 1592 as part of the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War by a Dutch and English force under Maurice of Orange. By taking Steenwijk the Republic's army would take out one of the two main transport routes overland to the Drenthe capital of Groningen, the other lay at Coevorden.

zh.s: 1592年5月30日至7月5日，奥兰治的毛里茨率领荷兰和英格兰联军围攻斯滕韦克。这场围城战发生在八十年战争和英西战争期间。攻占斯滕韦克后，荷兰共和国军队将切断通往德伦特首府格罗宁根的两条主要陆路运输线之一；另一条经过库福尔登。

en.s: The Campaign of Danture comprised a series of encounters between the Portuguese and the Kingdom of Kandy in 1594, part of the Sinhalese–Portuguese War. It is considered a turning point in the indigenous resistance to Portuguese expansion. For the first time in Sri Lanka, a Portuguese army was essentially annihilated, when they were on the verge of the total conquest of the island.

zh.s: 丹图尔战役是1594年葡萄牙人与康提王国之间的一系列交战，属于僧伽罗—葡萄牙战争的一部分。这场战役被视为当地人抵抗葡萄牙扩张的转折点。葡萄牙军队几乎全军覆没，这在斯里兰卡尚属首次；当时他们已接近征服全岛。

en.s: The siege of Ostend was a three-year siege of the city of Ostend during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. A Spanish force under Archduke Albrecht besieged the fortress being held initially by a Dutch force which was reinforced by English troops under Francis Vere, who became the town's governor. It was said "the Spanish assailed the unassailable; the Dutch defended the indefensible."

zh.s: 奥斯坦德围城战是八十年战争和英西战争期间对奥斯坦德长达三年的围城战。奥地利的阿尔布雷希特大公率领西班牙军队围攻这座要塞。要塞最初由荷兰军队驻守，之后英国军队前来增援，弗朗西斯·维尔成为该城总督。当时有说法称：“西班牙人攻打不可攻克之地，荷兰人守卫不可防守之地。”

en.s: The Battle of Guzów (Polish: Bitwa pod Guzowem) took place on 5 July 1607, at the village of Guzów in Szydłowiec County, Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. The confrontation was between the forces of the Zebrzydowski Rebellion (10,000 infantry and 600 cavalry under Mikołaj Zebrzydowski and Janusz Radziwiłł) against the Royalists supporting King Sigismund III Vasa (9,100 infantry, 3,200 cavalry, and 24 cannon), under the command of Polish Grand Crown Hetman (commander-in-chief) Stanisław Żółkiewski and the Lithuanian Hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz.

zh.s: 古祖夫战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Guzowem）于1607年7月5日在波兰立陶宛联邦希德沃维茨县的古祖夫村爆发。泽布日多夫斯基叛乱军由米科瓦伊·泽布日多夫斯基和雅努什·拉齐维乌率领，包括10,000名步兵和600名骑兵；他们的对手是支持西吉斯蒙德三世·瓦萨国王的保王党军，共有9,100名步兵、3,200名骑兵和24门火炮，由波兰王冠大盖特曼（总司令）斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基和立陶宛盖特曼扬·卡罗尔·霍德凯维奇指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Kilmacrennan was a skirmish fought near Kilmacrennan, County Donegal in 1608 during O'Doherty's Rebellion. Sir Cahir O'Doherty was a traditional supporter of the Crown whose treatment at the hands of local officials had led him to launch a rebellion in which he had seized the garrison town of Derry, killing his enemy George Paulet.

zh.s: 基尔马克雷南之战是1608年奥多赫蒂叛乱期间在爱尔兰多尼戈尔郡基尔马克雷南附近发生的一场小规模交战。卡希尔·奥多赫蒂爵士原本支持王室，但当地官员对他的处置促使他发动叛乱；他曾攻占德里驻军城，并杀死政敌乔治·保莱特。

en.s: The English Civil War battle of Lansdowne (or Lansdown) was fought on 5 July 1643, near Bath, Somerset, southwest England. Although the Royalists under Lord Hopton forced the Parliamentarians under Sir William Waller to retreat from their hilltop position, they suffered so many casualties themselves and were left so disordered and short of ammunition that an injured Hopton was forced to retire.

zh.s: 英国内战中的兰斯当战役（又作Lansdown）于1643年7月5日在英格兰西南部萨默塞特郡巴斯附近爆发。霍普顿勋爵率领的保王党军迫使威廉·沃勒爵士率领的议会军撤离山顶阵地，但保王党也伤亡惨重，阵形混乱且弹药不足。受伤的霍普顿因此被迫撤退。

en.s: The siege of Malmö (Swedish: Belägringen av Malmö) was an unsuccessful Danish siege on the Swedish-held city of Malmö, fought between June 11 and July 5, 1677. Fought towards the end of the Scanian War, the siege was one in a string of Danish losses that saw Swedish forces under King Charles XI of Sweden establish control over the southern region of Sweden.

zh.s: 马尔默围城战（瑞典语：Belägringen av Malmö）是丹麦军队对瑞典控制的马尔默城发动的一次失败围攻，战事从1677年6月11日持续到7月5日。围城战发生在斯堪尼亚战争末期，是丹麦一连串败仗之一；在这些战事中，瑞典国王卡尔十一世率军控制了瑞典南部地区。

en.t: Isaac Newton publishes Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica
en.s: Sir Isaac Newton ( ; 4 January 1643 [O.S. 25 December 1642] – 31 March 1727 [O.S. 20 March 1726]) was an English polymath who was a mathematician, physicist, astronomer, alchemist, theologian, author and inventor. He was a key figure in the Scientific Revolution and the Enlightenment that followed. His book Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica (Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy), first published in 1687, achieved the first great unification in physics and established classical mechanics.

zh.t: 艾萨克·牛顿出版《自然哲学的数学原理》
zh.s: 艾萨克·牛顿爵士（1643年1月4日〔儒略历1642年12月25日〕—1727年3月31日〔儒略历1727年3月20日〕）是英国博学家，涉足数学、物理学、天文学、炼金术、神学、写作和发明等领域。他是科学革命和随后启蒙运动的关键人物。其著作《自然哲学的数学原理》于1687年首次出版，实现了物理学的首次重大统一，并奠定了经典力学。

en.s: The Le Havre raid was a two-day naval bombardment of the French port of Le Havre early in July 1759 by a Royal Navy fleet under Rear-Admiral of the Blue George Rodney during the Seven Years' War, which succeeded in its aim of destroying many of the invasion barges being gathered there for the planned French invasion of Britain.

en.s: The Battle of Chesma (also known as the Battle of Chesme, Battle of Cheshme or Battle of Cesme Bay) took place on 5–7 July 1770 in and near Çeşme, in the area between the western tip of Anatolia and the island of Chios, which was the site of a number of past naval battles between the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Venice.

zh.s: 切什梅海战又称切什梅战役、切什梅湾战役或切什梅湾海战，于1770年7月5日至7日在切什梅及其附近海域爆发。战场位于安纳托利亚西端与希俄斯岛之间，这一带过去曾发生过多场奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯共和国之间的海战。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: The Second Continental Congress adopts the Olive Branch Petition.

zh.s: 第二届大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三个殖民地的代表组成，代表们团结起来支持美国革命和独立战争，最终促成美国脱离英国独立。会议建立了一个新的联邦，最初称为“北美联合殖民地”；1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 第二届大陆会议通过《橄榄枝请愿书》。

en.s: The 1792 imperial election, held on 5 July 1792 in Frankfurt, elected Francis of the House of Habsburg as the final Holy Roman Emperor, succeeding his father, Leopold II, who died on 1 March 1792. The seven prince-electors unanimously chose Francis.

zh.s: 1792年7月5日，神圣罗马帝国在法兰克福举行皇帝选举。七位选帝侯一致选出哈布斯堡家族的弗朗茨，接替于同年3月1日去世的父亲利奥波德二世，成为神圣罗马帝国最后一位皇帝。

en.s: The First Battle of Châtillon (5 July 1793) during the War in the Vendée saw the Vendean Royalists defeat a French Republican raiding force led by François-Joseph Westermann. The rebel Catholic and Royal Army virtually destroyed the Republican column, only Westermann and a few hundred cavalrymen escaping the disaster. The Vendée revolt was a bitter civil war waged between those who supported the French Revolution and rural farmers who resented the new government's anti-Catholic laws and conscription decrees.

zh.s: 1793年7月5日，旺代战争期间，旺代保王党击败了弗朗索瓦-约瑟夫·韦斯特曼率领的一支法国共和军突袭部队。叛军的天主教与保王党军几乎全歼共和军纵队，只有韦斯特曼和数百名骑兵逃过一劫。旺代起义是一场激烈的内战，交战双方分别是支持法国大革命的人，以及不满新政府反天主教法律和征兵法令的农村农民。

en.s: The Battle of Rastatt (5 July 1796) saw part of a Republican French army under Jean Victor Marie Moreau clash with elements of a Habsburg Austrian army under Maximilian Anton Karl, Count Baillet de Latour which were defending the line of the Murg River. Leading a wing of Moreau's army, Louis Desaix attacked the Austrians and drove them back to the Alb River in the War of the First Coalition action. Rastatt is a city in the state of Baden-Württemberg in Germany, located 89 kilometres (55 mi) south of Mannheim and 94 kilometres (58 mi) west of Stuttgart.

zh.s: 1796年7月5日，第一次反法同盟战争期间，法国共和军的一部分在让-维克托·马里·莫罗率领下，与哈布斯堡奥地利军队交战。奥军由马克西米利安·安东·卡尔·拜耶·德·拉图尔伯爵率领，负责防守穆尔格河防线。莫罗军中的路易·德赛率一支部队发起进攻，将奥军击退至阿尔布河。拉施塔特是德国巴登-符腾堡州的一座城市，位于曼海姆以南89公里（55英里）、斯图加特以西94公里（58英里）。

en.s: The Convention of Artlenburg or Elbkonvention was the surrender of the Electorate of Hanover to Napoleon's army, signed at Artlenburg on 5 July 1803 by Oberbefehlshaber Johann Ludwig von Wallmoden-Gimborn. It disbanded the Electorate of Hanover and instigated its occupation by French troops.

zh.s: 阿特伦堡协定（又称易北河协定）是汉诺威选侯国向拿破仑军队投降的协定，由总司令约翰·路德维希·冯·瓦尔莫登-金博恩于1803年7月5日在阿特伦堡签署。协定解散了汉诺威选侯国，并开启法军对该地的占领。

en.s: Battle of the Retiro (Spanish: Combate del Retiro) was a battle produced during the second British Invasion of the Río de la Plata, between the Spanish troops, led by Santiago de Liniers, and the British forces under John Whitelocke.

zh.s: 雷蒂罗之战（西班牙语：Combate del Retiro）是拉普拉塔河第二次英国入侵期间的一场战斗。西班牙军由圣地亚哥·德·利尼尔斯率领，英军由约翰·惠特洛克率领。

en.s: The Battle of Wagram (5–6 July 1809) was a military engagement of the Napoleonic Wars and ended in a decisive victory for Emperor Napoleon I's French and allied army against the Austrian army under the command of Archduke Charles of Austria-Teschen. The battle led to the breakup of the Fifth Coalition, the Austrian and British-led alliance against France. In 1809, the French military presence in Germany was diminished as Napoleon transferred a number of soldiers to fight in the Peninsular War. As a result, the Austrian Empire saw its chance to recover some of its former sphere of influence and invaded the Kingdom of Bavaria, a French ally.

zh.s: 瓦格拉姆战役于1809年7月5日至6日爆发，是拿破仑战争中的一场战斗。拿破仑一世皇帝率领法国及其盟军，击败了由奥地利-泰申的卡尔大公指挥的奥军，取得决定性胜利。此战导致第五次反法同盟瓦解；该同盟由奥地利和英国主导，旨在对抗法国。1809年，拿破仑调派部分军队参加半岛战争，法国驻德兵力因此减少。奥地利帝国趁机试图恢复昔日的势力范围，入侵法国的盟友巴伐利亚王国。

en.s: The Battle of Hörnefors took place during the Finnish War, on 5 July 1809, when 2,400 Swedes under Johan August Sandels went on a counter-offensive against 3,350 Russians under Ilya Alekseyev and Pavel Shuvalov, at Hörnefors, Sweden. After more than two hours of intense fighting along the Hörnån (river) Sandels ordered a retreat, after having been misinformed of a greater Russian flanking attack.

zh.s: 1809年7月5日，芬兰战争期间，约翰·奥古斯特·桑德尔斯率领2,400名瑞典军人在瑞典赫讷福什向伊利亚·阿列克谢耶夫和帕维尔·舒瓦洛夫率领的3,350名俄军发起反攻。双方沿赫尔南河激战两个多小时后，桑德尔斯因误信俄军将从侧翼发动更大规模的进攻，下令撤退。

en.s: The Venezuelan Independence was the juridical-political process that put an end to the ties between the Captaincy General of Venezuela and the Spanish Empire. It also implied the replacement of the absolute monarchy by the republic as the form of government in Venezuela. The independence of Venezuela produced the armed conflict known as the Venezuelan War of Independence between the independence army or Patriotas ("patriots") and the royalist army or Realistas ("royalists"). On July 5, 1811, the independence declaration is signed.

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 1945 was held on 5 July 1945, with polls in some constituencies delayed until 12 July and in Nelson and Colne until 19 July, because of local wakes weeks. en.s: The Battle of Osan (Korean: 오산 전투) was the first engagement between United States and North Korean forces during the Korean War, on July 5, 1950. Task Force Smith, a U.S. task force of 400 infantry supported by an artillery battery, was moved to Osan, south of the South Korean capital Seoul, and ordered to fight as a rearguard to delay advancing North Korean forces while additional U.S. troops arrived in the country to form a stronger defensive line to the south. The task force lacked both anti-tank guns and effective infantry anti-tank weapons, having been equipped with obsolescent 2.36-in. rocket launchers and a few 57 mm recoilless rifles.

en.t: K-1 World MAX 2003 World Tournament final
en.s: K-1 World MAX 2003 World Tournament Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the second ever K-1 MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/154 lb weight class) involving eight finalists and two reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. The tournament fighters had qualified via preliminary tournaments, had been involved in the previous years final, or had been invited due to their achievements in kickboxing and Muay Thai (more information on the fighters is detailed by the bulleted list below). As well as tournament bouts there was also a super fight, also fought under K-1 rules. In total there were twelve fighters at the event, representing seven countries. The tournament winner was the home favourite Masato who defeated reigning champion Albert Kraus by knockout, in what was a very entertaining event with five stoppages in the eight bouts. Both Masato and Kraus had challenging routes to the final with Masato having a close decision victory over Mike Zambidis and Kraus overcoming up and comer and future K-1 MAX champion Andy Souwer in the quarter-finals. The event was held in Saitama at the Saitama Super Arena, on Saturday, 5 July 2003.

zh.t: K-1 World MAX 2003世界锦标赛决赛

en.t: The World Health Organization announces that the 2002–2004 SARS outbreak has been contained
en.s: The 2002–2004 outbreak of SARS, caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS-CoV or SARS-CoV-1), infected over 8,000 people from 30 countries and territories, and resulted in at least 774 deaths worldwide. The outbreak was first identified in Foshan, Guangdong, China, in November 2002. The World Health Organization (WHO) was notified of the outbreak in February 2003, and issued a global alert in March 2003.

en.t: The Staffordshire Hoard, the largest collection of Anglo-Saxon gold ever discovered, consisting of more than 1,500 items (examples pictured), was found near Hammerwich in Staffordshire
en.s: The Staffordshire Hoard is the largest hoard of Anglo-Saxon gold and silver metalwork yet found. It consists of almost 4,600 items and metal fragments, amounting to a total of 5.1 kg (11 lb) of gold, 1.4 kg (3 lb) of silver and some 3,500 pieces of garnet cloisonné jewellery. It is described by the historian Cat Jarman as "possibly the finest collection of early medieval artefacts ever discovered".

zh.s: 斯塔福德郡宝藏是迄今发现的最大批盎格鲁-撒克逊金银器物，包含近4,600件物品和金属碎片，总计有5.1千克（11磅）黄金、1.4千克（3磅）白银，以及约3,500件石榴石镶嵌珠宝。历史学家凯特·贾曼称其“可能是迄今发现的最精美的早期中世纪文物收藏”。

en.t: 10th general convention of Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Socialist)
en.s: 10th general convention of Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Socialist) was held for 1–5 July 2024 to elect central committee members and portfolios. The five day schedule program was held in national capital, Kathmandu of Nepal. 1,849 delegates were elected from constituencies and clusters to elect 299 central committee members and 21 office bearers.

zh.t: 尼泊尔共产党（联合社会主义）第十次全国代表大会
zh.s: 尼泊尔共产党（联合社会主义）第十次全国代表大会于2024年7月1日至5日举行，选举中央委员会成员和各项职务。为期五天的会议在尼泊尔首都加德满都举行。大会从各选区和类别中选出1,849名代表，由他们选举299名中央委员会成员和21名党内负责人。

en.t: Keir Starmer is appointed Prime Minister by Charles III, becoming the first Labour prime minister since Gordon Brown in 2010 and the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair at the 2005 general election
en.s: Sir Keir Rodney Starmer (born 2 September 1962) is a British politician and former lawyer who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 2024 to 2026. He was Leader of the Labour Party from 2020 to 2026 and Leader of the Opposition from 2020 to 2024. He was the Member of Parliament (MP) for Holborn and St Pancras from 2015 to 2026.

zh.s: 基尔·罗德尼·斯塔默爵士（1962年9月2日出生）是英国政治人物和前律师，2024年至2026年担任英国首相。他于2020年至2026年担任工党领袖，并于2020年至2024年担任反对党领袖。2015年至2026年，他担任霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯选区议员。

en.s: The 2025 Algerian Cup final was the 58th final of the Algerian Cup. The final was contested between holders CR Belouizdad and local rivals USM Alger. It was the sixth time that the two teams meet in the final, and the first since 2003. USM Alger claimed a 2–0 victory over CR Belouizdad in the Algerian Cup final with early goals from Benayad and Khaldi.

zh.s: 2025年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是该赛事的第58届决赛，由卫冕冠军CR贝鲁伊兹达德队对阵同城对手USM阿尔及尔队。两队这是第6次在决赛相遇，也是自2003年以来首次交手。USM阿尔及尔以2比0击败CR贝鲁伊兹达德，贝纳亚德和哈勒迪在比赛早段进球。
